sources.title: Robust inventory control under demand and lead time uncertainty

locations.topic: Monotone cumulative arrival indicators and a finite maximum delivery deadline; crossing orders permitted.

recommended_upgrade.name: maximum-deadline commitment inequality with deferred fixed-deadline loss ledger
recommended_upgrade.real_arrivals: Successful batch j dispatched at tau_j arrives at an unknown a_j in[tau_j+Lmin,tau_j+Lmax]; early successes received immediately; order crossings allowed.
recommended_upgrade.loss_information: No absence before tau_j+Lmax is called loss. Earlier genuine failure telemetry may be observed, but replenishment settlement is deferred to the fixed latest deadline. Actual telemetry and ledger timestamps must be stored separately.
recommended_upgrade.loss_budget_clock: Use failed-batch dispatch-date rolling budget or equivalent fixedLmax deadline-settlement rolling budget. Do not transfer variable early-confirmation budgets without a new envelope.
recommended_upgrade.controller: Original causal IP feedback, using actual received fresh water, recoverable backlog and unsettled promised water; individual future lead times never enter the rule.
recommended_upgrade.no_extra_quarantine: The controller counts real early receipts immediately. IP<=r and Y,P>=0 imply physicalW<=r, so no additional quarantine capacity is needed merely to prove this extension.
recommended_upgrade.startup: For t<Lmax, P_t<=Q*N_t and whole-history common-fault lemma imply d_t+P_t+Y_t<=A(t+1)<=A(Lmax)<=r7; it is not necessary or true to assume no early arrivals.
recommended_upgrade.resource_boundary: Actual dispatch availability must still satisfy the rollingB support after fleet effects. Independently require enough replacement/return capacity for boundedTturn_max, e.g.F>=ceil(Tturn_max/Delta).

recommended_upgrade.optimality_scope: Sufficient hard-support bound for the given causal policy; not an exact all-policy reserve optimum or a probability guarantee.

The weak inequality at the boundary is essential. Take min withr6(Lmax) only when both supports hold. Count latent failed cargo too.
recommended_upgrade.loss_batch_daily_count: FixedglobalLmax plus at most one dispatch/day implies at most one failed full batch settled/day, as required for b_J remainder min(J,nmodP). Heterogeneous offsets or variable early settlements need a new loss envelope.

counterexamples.example: Failed dispatches0and365 obeyJ1/rolling365dispatchdays; confirmations90and410 (lags90and45) violateJ1/rolling365observationdays; fixedM90settlements90and455 preserve the budget.

counterexamples.name: false nominal-timeout loss
counterexamples.example: Calling a still-bounded delayed shipment lost before its latest deadline then accepting it later breaks the ledger or requires negative loss corrections, invalidating monotoneH arguments.

counterexamples.name: unbounded delay or permanent hull loss
counterexamples.example: No finite resolution horizon or insufficient replacement fleet can defeat any finite reserve and the assumed opportunity service support.
